Every technical figure that circulates for 川气东送 is a SYSTEM or MAINLINE figure and none of them may be staged on this 50-53 km branch: 2270 km 全线设计总长 and 1611.7 km 主干管道 (sohu 278023532); 2170 km 管道总长 (thepaper 1578871 — note it disagrees with sohu, another trunk-row question); 1702 公里 mainline (Jiangxi DRC plan); 1016 mm 主干管道管径; 10 MPa 设计压力; 120亿立方米/年 设计输气量; 626.76亿元 总投资 (includes the Puguang field); 2010-08-31 投运 (the trunk's commissioning, two months AFTER this branch began supplying Jiangxi). The branch's own Capacity (3.00 bcm/y), Diameter (508 mm), Pressure, SegmentCost, ConstructionYear and ProposalYear are therefore left UNRESOLVED rather than filled from these. The row's EXISTENCE and CLASSIFICATION are not in question: NDRC names 江西支线 individually in the national tariff schedule and the operator's own 2021 EIA acceptance names it as a live gas source.

NOTE three MUTUALLY INCONSISTENT trunk lengths now on the table for P4657, which left Length UNRESOLVED: 1611.7 km 主干管道 (sohu), 2170 km 管道总长 (thepaper 1578871), 2270 km 全线设计总长 incl. branches (sohu), and 全长约1702公里 for the mainline in the Jiangxi DRC plan https://img9.qianzhan.com/policy/202307/14/20230714-d7d735aa6fb9eae9.pdf (verified OK). Pressure 10 MPa and Diameter 1016 mm are sourceable for the TRUNK from this page, which P4657 left UNRESOLVED.

九江市《'十四五'能源发展规划》 (municipal government, 2023-06-09, verified OK): '“十三五”和“十四五”江西省天然气管网一期工程(永修—武宁—修水支线、湖口—彭泽支线、蔡岭—都昌支线)开工建设，随着项目的建成投运将进一步优化九江市能源结构' and in the 十四五 tasks '继续完成省级天然气长输管网永修—武宁—修水支线、湖口—彭泽支线建设'. Segment-naming evidence that 永修—武宁—修水支线 was under construction and NOT yet in service as of June 2023 — bears directly on that row's status and construction dates.

Same Jiujiang 十四五 energy plan names 蔡岭—都昌支线 as one of the three Phase I branches begun in the 十三五/十四五 period ('江西省天然气管网一期工程(永修—武宁—修水支线、湖口—彭泽支线、蔡岭—都昌支线)开工建设'). Segment-naming evidence for construction timing/status of the Cailing-Duchang branch.

江西省发改委 赣发改规划〔2014〕325号《江西省天然气利用规划(2013-2020年)》 (verified OK with --name 江西专线). PHASE IDENTITY, stated by the provincial regulator: '承接川气东送工程气源的江西省天然气管网一期工程已建成管道 870 公里，主要建成九江—南昌、九江-沙河、九江-景德镇、南昌-丰城、高安-新余、丰城-抚州 6 条干线和田南-上高支线。承接西气东输二线、三线工程气源的江西省天然气管网二期工程已建成管道 98 公里，主要建成吉安首段、赣州首段、安义段 3 条管线和宜春、萍乡对接工程'. This is the cleanest source for the Phase I = 川气东送 feed / Phase II = WEP2+WEP3 feed split in RELAUNCH_NOTES item 2 and 4, and it pins which trunks existed by 2014. 870 km is an AGGREGATE for six trunks plus a branch — do not stage it on any single segment.

Jiangxi DRC 2014 plan lists 九江-景德镇 among the six Phase I trunks ALREADY BUILT ('已建成管道 870 公里，主要建成九江—南昌、九江-沙河、九江-景德镇、南昌-丰城、高安-新余、丰城-抚州 6 条干线和田南-上高支线'). Segment-naming corroboration that the line was complete before 2014 — bears on the 2009-vs-2010 start cluster (RELAUNCH_NOTES item 5): the plan establishes an upper bound, not the year. FuelSource for all six: 承接川气东送工程气源 (i.e. via P4649, the 江西支线).

Jiangxi DRC 2014 plan: 九江—南昌 named among the six Phase I trunks already built by 2014, feed = 承接川气东送工程气源. Same 870 km aggregate caveat. Upper bound on completion, and a segment-naming FuelSource source.
Jiangxi DRC 2014 plan: 九江-沙河 named among the six Phase I trunks already built by 2014, feed = 承接川气东送工程气源. Same 870 km aggregate caveat.
Jiangxi DRC 2014 plan: 南昌-丰城 named among the six Phase I trunks already built by 2014, feed = 承接川气东送工程气源. Same 870 km aggregate caveat.

Jiangxi DRC 2014 plan, section (二)西气东输二线工程: '该工程包括一干八支…管道总长8653公里，设计输气能力300亿立方米/年…该工程在江西境内主要建设“一干两支”即主干线、樟树-湘潭支干线和南昌-上海支干线，呈“十字架”型布局，途经除景德镇外的10个设区市，管道长1097公里，于2011年9月开始向江西供气'. 1097 km is the JIANGXI-WIDE aggregate for the trunk plus BOTH branches — do not stage it on the 南昌-上海支干线 alone; 2011-09 is the Jiangxi gas-in date for the WEP2 system in the province. 8653 km / 300亿立方米 are WEP2 SYSTEM figures.

Same Jiangxi DRC 2014 passage names 樟树-湘潭支干线 as one of the two WEP2 支干线 in Jiangxi ('一干两支'), inside the 1097 km Jiangxi-wide aggregate, with the province's WEP2 supply starting 2011-09. Segment-naming existence/timing evidence; the 1097 km figure is an aggregate of three lines.
